question: Paras, Mani, Kajal, Kunj, Vani and Saras are sitting around a circle, facing the centre. Saras sits third to the left of Vani. Vani sits second to the right of Paras. Kunj sits second to the left of Kajal. Who sits to the immediate right of Mani?
solution:
Paras, Mani, Kajal, Kunj, Vani and Saras are sitting around a circle, facing the centre.

 
• Saras sits third to the left of Vani.
 
• Vani sits second to the right of Paras.
 
• Kunj sits second to the left of Kajal.
